lines.text: واحد فلذلك يكون خطّ {ov:د ن} الذي هو بُعْد الشمس عن مركز الارض مِثْل خطّ {ov:م ن} الذي هو نصف

lines.text: قُطْر الارض الفًا ومائتين وعشر مرّة{n:14} بالتقريب وامّا قطر الشمس فمثْل قطر القمر ثماني عشرة مرّة

lines.text: واربعة اخماس بالتقريب ولكن قطر الارض مثل قطر القمر ثلث مرّات وخُمْسَي مرّة بالتقريب فقطر

lines.text: الشمس مثل قطر الارض خمس مرّات ونصفًا. ﴿ والمُكَعَّب ﴾ ذو الطُّول والعَرْض والغَمْق الذي يكون{mL:15}

lines.text: من ضرب الواحد في مثله ثمّ في واحد يكون واحدًا اعني مكعَّب الارض. والمكعَّب الذي يكون من

lines.text: ستّة آلاف وستّمائة واربعة واربعين ونصفًا. والمكعَّب الذي يكون من ضرب قطر القمر في مثله ثمّ في قطر

observations: L01, L03, L04, L05, L06, L11, L13, L21: long joins (بـه, هـو, اخمـاس, الواحـد, مِثـل twice, انّـه, خـطّ, مـن, وامّـا, فمثـل, ستّـة) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of يكون (L02), كلّه (L09), ولكن (L14) and والمُكَعَّب (L15).

The page continues chapter 30; it has no heading, no figure and no printer's signature. Its 21 lines all run the full measure (72 to 496 pt): no paragraph begins or ends on the page. On L15 the word «والمُكَعَّب» stands between the ornamental brackets, after the full stop, and at the end of L20 the words «فعِظْم الشمس». Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the left margin and the folio number «f. 61,r.» in the right margin beside L11, where an asterisk, after the reference to note 12, marks the folio's first word وخطّ.

The letters of the figure of p. 89 are overlined, each group under its own bar (12.2 to 21.4 pt): {ov:ف ن} (L01, L02, L04), {ov:م ن} (L01, L05, L06, L11, L12), {ov:ط ح} (L02, L03, L05, L10), {ov:ف ض} (L03 twice, L04, L05), {ov:ط ن} (L04, L07, L08, L09, L11 twice), {ov:ط ق} (L04), {ov:د ل} (L07), {ov:د ط} (L08), {ov:د ن} (L09 twice, L11, L12), {ov:د ا} (L10) and {ov:ه ح} (L20), whose first letter is the small round hā' (2.8 x 3.1 pt). The order of the letters of each group is that of the ink under its bar, from right to left (scratch barunder.py).

Abjad numerals, each under one bar: {ov:سد ي} 64;10 (L02, L11; 19.3 and 18.7 pt); {ov:{0} يز لج} 0;17,33 (L03, L05; 24.8 and 23.8 pt); {ov:{0} مه لح} 0;45,38 (L03, L05; 24.5 and 23.4 pt); {ov:{0} ج يا} 0;3,11 (L08, 23.6 pt); {ov:{0} نو مط} 0;56,49 (L08), whose bar is set in two pieces, 17.4 pt over the zero sign and نو and 8.4 pt over مط, 1.2 pt apart. The first sign of six of them is the codex's zero sign, the flat-topped sort (5.4-5.8 x 4.4-4.6 pt).
Final yā': with its two dots in الذي, في, بقي (L07), ثمانِيَ (L09), ثماني (L10, L13), الثماني (L18), وهي (L10), اعني (L16) and وخُمْسَي (L14); without dots in الى (L03, L11) and واحدى (L06, L07).

L01: خطّ (throughout the page), ستّين, وستّين, ستّ, ستّة, وستّة, وستّمائة, وامّا, كلّه, مرّة, مرّات and ثمّ: a shadda. جزءًا (L01, L02, L06, L09, L20): after the zāy the hamza with the fathatan above it in one cluster (4.0 x 5.8-6.1 pt), before the alif; جزء (L11): the bare hamza on the line. The references to notes 1 (L01) and 2 (L02) after {ov:ف ن}. واحدًا (L02, L09, L16), جميعًا (L04), ايضًا (L08, L10), الفًا (L13), ونصفًا (L15, L19), وربعًا and وثمنًا (L21): fathatan.
L03: the reference to note 3 after the numeral. فنِسْبة (L03) and نِسْبة (L10): a kasra under the nūn and a round sukun over the sīn; نسبة (L03): no signs.

L04: فمساوٍ: under the wāw the kasratan; its two strokes run together in the master scan (3.6 x 2.8 pt, slant 25) and stand apart in the second copy. The references to note 4 after {ov:ف ن}, to note 5 after {ov:ط ق} and to note 6 after ضِعْف. مِثْل (L04, L12, L21): a kasra under the mīm and a round sukun on top of the three dots of the thā'; فمثْل (L13): the sukun only (a ring in the second copy); مثل (L14, L15, L21) and مثله, مثلها: no signs. ضِعْف: a kasra under the ḍād and a round sukun over the ʿayn.

L05: جُمِعَ: a damma over the jīm, a kasra under the mīm and a fatha over the ʿayn. أنّه (L05, L11): the bare hamza over the alif and a shadda over the nūn; the second انّه of L05 has the shadda only. أخماس (L09): the bare hamza over the alif; اخماس (L03, L10, L14, L18 twice): none.

L06: مَبْلَغ: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the bā' and a fatha over the lām. وثلٰث (L06) and ثلٰث (L07): a small upright alif (1.8 x 3.6 pt, 9.4 to 13.0 pt over the baseline) above the lām, in both copies; ثلث (L14), والثلثة (L03) and وثلثين (L20) have none. دقائق (L06, L07), مائة (L17, L21), ومائتين (L13) and وستّمائة (L19, L21): the hamza over its tooth. المَثلَيْن (L06, L07) and المَثل (L07): so printed, in both copies: a fatha over the ligature of the lām and the mīm, no sign with the three dots of the thā', and in المَثلَيْن a fatha over the second lām and a round sukun over the yā' (a ring in the second copy); the word is مِثْل, with a kasra, on L04, L12 and L21. After المَثلَيْن of L06 the reference is printed «2», in both copies; the note that belongs to the place is note 7 («Cod. المثلثين»), between the references to notes 6 (L04) and 8 (L07, after the second المَثلَيْن): it is kept as printed. فإِذا (L06, L08): the hamza and its kasra in one sort under the alif. أُسْقِطَ: over the alif the hamza with a damma above it in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt), a round sukun over the sīn, a kasra under the qāf and a fatha over the ṭā'.
L08: the full stop after ثانية. The references to note 9 after {ov:ط ن} and to note 10 after {ov:د ط}. جُعِل: a damma over the jīm and a kasra under the ʿayn.

L09: يعُدُّ: a damma over the ʿayn and, over the dāl, a shadda with a damma in one cluster (3.2 x 6.5 pt); يعُدّ (L10): a damma over the ʿayn and a shadda over the dāl. ثمانِيَ: a fatha over the yā'; under the nūn, beside the two dots of the yā', a short slanted mark (1.6 x 1.3 pt, slant 28; a dot in the second copy): the kasra, printed short (ثمانِيَةَ on L18 has it whole, 2.9 x 1.8 pt). عَشْرَةَ: a fatha over the ʿayn, a round sukun on top of the three dots of the shīn, a fatha over the rā' and a fatha over the tā' marbūṭa; عشرة (L06, L07, L10, L13, L18): no signs. مرّةً: over the tā' marbūṭa the fathatan. The full stop after بالتقريب.

L11: the references to note 11 after {ov:د ن}, to note 12 after the first {ov:ط ن} and to note 13 after {ov:م ن}. بانَ: a fatha over the nūn; بان (L05 twice): none. خطًّا: over the ṭā' a shadda with the fathatan above it (two marks).
L12: بُعْد: a damma over the bā' and a round sukun over the ʿayn; بعد (L02): no signs.

L13: قُطْر: a damma over the qāf, above its two dots, and a round sukun over the ṭā'; قطر (elsewhere on the page) and فقطر: no signs. وعشر: the tail of the rā' is printed apart from its head (4.7 x 2.9 pt, 2.5 to 5.4 pt under the baseline); it is not a kasra. The reference to note 14 after مرّة.
L14: وخُمْسَي: a damma over the khā', above its dot, a round sukun over the mīm and a short fatha over the sīn.

L15: the full stop after ونصفًا. والمُكَعَّب: a damma over the ligature of the lām and the mīm, its tail printed apart from its head (the head 2.5 x 2.9 pt; a small damma in the second copy), a fatha over the kāf and, over the ʿayn, a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks); مكعَّب (L16) and والمكعَّب (L16, L17, L19): the shadda with the fatha above it only; مكعّب (L20): the shadda only. الطُّول: over the ṭā' a shadda with a damma in one cluster (3.6 x 6.5 pt). والعَرْض: a fatha over the ʿayn and a round sukun over the rā'. والغَمْق: so printed, in both copies: the letter after the article has a dot over it (2.2 x 2.2 pt, 5.4 to 7.6 pt over the baseline, under the fatha), a ghayn where the word is العمق, the depth; a fatha stands over it and a round sukun over the mīm (a ring in the second copy). The word is not in Nallino's corrigenda; it is kept as printed.
L16: the full stop after الارض.

L17: the reference to note 15 after والنصف. ورُبْعًا: a damma over the rā', a round sukun over the bā' and the fathatan; ورُبْع (L20): the damma and the sukun; وربعًا (L21): the fathatan only. وثُمْنًا: a damma over the three dots of the thā', a round sukun over the mīm and the fathatan; وثمنًا (L21): the fathatan only. The full stop after وثُمْنًا.
L18: the reference to note 16 after والاربعة. ثمانِيَةَ: a kasra under the nūn, a fatha over the yā' and a fatha over the tā' marbūṭa. عَشَرَ: fathas over the ʿayn, the shīn and the rā'.
L19: آلاف (L19, L21): the madda over the alif. The full stop after ونصفًا.
L20: the reference to note 17 after وثلثين. فعِظْم (L20) and عِظْم (L21 twice): a kasra under the ʿayn and a round sukun over the ẓā', above its dot.
L21: وستًّا: over the tā' a shadda with the fathatan above it (two marks). ولكنَّه: over the nūn, above its dot, a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks).
